reason: The text the check read as a status message is the label of the Verify endpoint button, which sits disabled under the Endpoint URL field. It is a control, not a message about a result, success, error or progress.
criterionAnalysis: 4.1.3 covers status messages: results, success, errors and progress that appear without taking focus. Verify endpoint is a button label, and the button shows no outcome. The tree exposes it as button "Verify endpoint" [disabled=true], so 4.1.2 holds. The only real message on this screen is the URL error text, which uses the same aria-errormessage wiring as the API token finding and is not what this finding names.
